_comment: IsPlayerTeammate() is NOT universal -- this file exists because of that.
Read off Swiftly Order Squad's shipped IsFollower/IsDismissedCustomFollower,
which has solved this across a large user base.
DYNAMIC_OR_DROP: every entry resolves against the LIVE load order at
kDataLoaded and is skipped silently when its plugin is absent. Nothing here
is baked from this machine's load order -- an absent plugin is normal, not
an error, and must not be logged as one.

dismissedWhenActorValueEquals.name: Inigo
dismissedWhenActorValueEquals.note: Inigo does not use PlayerTeammate at all. His dismissed state is WaitingForPlayer == -1. One of the most-installed followers in existence, so this is not an edge case -- it is THE case the first design draft got wrong.

eligibleWhenFactionRankAtLeast.name: PetFramework
eligibleWhenFactionRankAtLeast.note: PetFramework_PetFollowingFaction rank >= 1 counts as a follower even without teammate status. DISABLED until the real form is confirmed on a list that ships it -- shipping a guessed FormID would silently match nothing, or worse, something else.
